correction_to_previous_interpretation.previous_claim: systemd-creds produced identical output for every key mode and another identity decrypted it, therefore its encryption was nominal
correction_to_previous_interpretation.why_it_was_wrong: the host key did not exist when the test began; each unprivileged call created or used it through a polkit-authorized privileged helper, and root could decrypt simply because root owns that key file
correction_to_previous_interpretation.corrected_conclusion: systemd-creds encryption was real, but unprivileged use requires polkit authorization on this host, so a systemd user service could not decrypt a credential without an interactive desktop prompt
correction_to_previous_interpretation.effect_on_decision: systemd-creds remains rejected, for a stronger and more accurate reason: it violates the non-negotiable no-Polkit-at-runtime requirement
